findings.pdf_says: RECORD { CONTAINS integer-1 CHARACTERS / IS VARYING IN SIZE [ [ FROM integer-2 ] [ TO integer-3 ] CHARACTERS ] (continuation line, indented:) [ DEPENDING ON data-name-1 ] / CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5 CHARACTERS }
findings.markdown_says:
│        │ IS <u>VARYING</u> IN SIZE [ [ FROM integer-2 ] [ <u>TO</u> integer-3 ] CHARACTERS ] │ │
│ <u>RECORD</u> ┤                                                                       ├ │ .
│        │ [ <u>DEPENDING</u> ON data-name-1 ]                                          │ │
findings.why_it_matters: In the SD general format (13.3.5.1), the printed [ DEPENDING ON data-name-1 ] is an indented continuation of the IS VARYING alternative. The markdown places it flush with the alternatives, separated by blank lines like the other alternatives, so the brace reads as four alternatives and RECORD [ DEPENDING ON data-name-1 ] alone looks legal (falsely permissive syntax).
